decision_context.purpose: Ticket details were dominated by test logs, making it hard to see why the work mattered.
decision_context.approach: Show five short explanations first; keep full reasoning and technical audit records in separate expandable sections.
choices: Use built-in browser dropdowns without adding dependencies.
Keep only an external specification link: rejected because it is harder to scan.
Generate reasons with an LLM: rejected because it could invent decisions.
decision_context.findings: The existing committed plans already contain useful reasoning. Reading those Git snapshots keeps explanations tied to auditable evidence.
decision_context.tradeoffs: Older tickets with missing or unrecognized sections say Not recorded. We preserve full source wording instead of pretending every ticket has a documented decision.
